title: LIBS Mapping of Mg/Ca ratios
author: Niklas Hausmann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zc9f2z6

steps.title: Section and clean shell samples
steps.instruction: Section shells at the hinge and along the direction of growth using an ISOMET 1000 Precision Saw (Buehler, 11-2180) with a Series 15LC Diamond Wafering Blade (No. 11-4276).

substeps.instruction: Remove non-hinge parts of the section if necessary to reduce overall size.
Select the better side of the two sections.
Clean the selected section with water and ethanol.

steps.title: Mount sample on XYZ stage
steps.instruction: Secure the shell section in a holder and place it on the translation stage.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a rudimentary holder ('Vesselheim') using crumpled aluminium foil.
Cradle the shell half into the holder so the section faces up and is near-horizontal.
Place the sample into the center of the STANDA XYZ stage (8MT200-100DCE).

steps.title: Configure LIBS system parameters
steps.instruction: Set up the Q-switched Nd:YAG laser and detection system for plasma analysis.

substeps.instruction: Set laser to operate at 1064 nm (infrared) with a pulse duration of 10 ns and energy of ~10 mJ.
Use a Thorlabs LMH-10X-1064 objective lens (10x magnification) to focus the beam onto the shell surface to sample an area of ~50µm.
Collect plasma plume light via quartz fibre into a Jobin Yvon TRIAX320 Czerny-Turner Spectrograph using a 600 l/nm grating.
Configure the Andor Technology DH520-18F ICCD sensor, synchronized with the laser Q-switch via a DG535 digital delay pulse generator, with a delay of 500 ns and a gating of 1000 ns.

steps.title: Measure and record Mg/Ca ratios
steps.instruction: Use a customized LabView setup to measure spectral peaks and record data.

substeps.instruction: Measure the peak at 279.553 nm for MgII.
Measure the peak at 315.887 nm for CaII.
Calculate the resulting ratio and associate it with the XYZ-stage location.
Save the data as a csv file.

steps.title: Generate elemental map in QGIS
steps.instruction: Plot the collected data to create a visual map of the shell section.

substeps.instruction: Use the xy-values from the csv file to plot a point cloud in QGIS.
Color each point by its respective Mg/Ca intensity ratio.
